method: Selected aggregates from an existing READ ONLY / REPEATABLE READ PostgreSQL collector snapshot. No new live query or provider sweep for this documentation update. Exact native attempt, provider message, chat, text/type and timestamp matching required.
limitations: Confirmed reply means exact native attempt and provider message ID/text in stored history, not proof that every question is resolved.
Receipt timestamps with whole-second provider precision allow up to one second for subsecond local attempt timestamps; exact chat, ID and text still required.
Mean latency includes backlog and recovery delays; no arbitrary trimming. First-response metric additionally excludes pairs with an intervening outgoing text.
Orders and sums belong to the shop, not sales causally attributable to Eva.
Order total is accounting order amount, not recognized revenue or profit.
No recorded manual outgoing is not proof that the owner was physically absent.
Stored native history may not cover unknown old provider dialogs. No full API sweep performed.
